notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Hey community! A small update is available now which fixes many cosmetic issues and file location issues!

Fixes:
- script updates
- when firing Magic, the projectiles would not appear
- the file location on Steam prevented launching from Steam menu

notes.title: Weekend update + follow socials for latest news!
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40862262/b5ecb3d869e7ca3d88c6c591d309d25d75a9e82f.png

Hello community! 

I hope your Thanksgiving holiday was alright! That you at least got some time off from work or school and got plenty to eat! 

This is a post touching base with you all about the state of OLIVANGO!
We currently have TWO titles out now:

CHILDHOOD GONE - Shadowed Wand = a Dragon Quest / Gameboy era Legend of Zelda / Ben Drowned internet creepypasta inspired open world turn based RPG game

AND

Echo of Extinction = a Mega Man boss format / open world crafting focused, party focused, turn based RPG set in post apocalypse Earth

Both of these titles are available NOW on Steam! 
Click the links above to read about them more!

There are a couple more games in the works as well. Look forward to seeing them when they are ready to go! 

This is also a post to remind you that you can follow OLIVANGO and all my news updates or other things on:

https://olivango.com/
and
https://youtube.com/@olivango?si=YoBR3xua37-uLPQB
or
https://www.facebook.com/olivango

I would try to make MORE Social Media accounts and all that on TikTok or wherever but I mainly just focus on making the games first. The FUN part! Eventually I will focus more on the promotional aspect of it all but it's still very early on in OLIVANGO's lifespan.

That's it for now folks! 

Have a great weekend and stay warm as we move into December! 
If you have any questions or concerns about this title or any title I've made, be sure to visit here:
https://olivango.com/contact-us
